author: Ankit
problem: Read strings S and T of lowercase letters and '?', with S longer than T. For each x from 0 to |T|, let S' be the first x characters of S followed by the last |T| - x characters of S; print Yes if S' matches T, otherwise No, where two characters match if they are equal or either is '?'. Print |T| + 1 lines.
bug_description: Compares N - M + i with ind instead of i, so suffix mismatches are ignored once S is longer than T.

comments.accurate: For each split x, the first x characters must match S's start and the rest must match S's end
comments.wrong_behavior: The last suffix mismatch is measured in S's positions, so it is shifted by the length difference N - M
comments.wrong_location: Split condition verified; check the suffix scan's negative indexing when S is much longer than T
comments.wrong_output: Example: input 'abcde\nab?' prints No Yes Yes Yes

source.buggy_line: print('Yes' if chk and N - M + i >= ind else 'No')
source.fixed_line: print('Yes' if chk and i >= ind else 'No')
